USC.identityStrategy: title + section (+ subsection) → normalized `N U.S.C. § X`
USC.parserRequirements: Reject shells < ~1KB meaningful text; verify section heading match
USC.citationVerification: Round-trip parseCitation → normalized form must equal identity
USC.failureQuarantine: quality_gate_failed rows must not enter ready corpus

FederalRules.authoritativeSourceRequirement: Official uscourts.gov or GPO federal rules text with rule numbers
FederalRules.identityStrategy: `Fed. R. Civ. P. N` / Evid / App / Crim
FederalRules.parserRequirements: Rule number extraction; strip navigation chrome

UsReports.authoritativeSourceRequirement: LOC U.S. Reports with machine-readable opinion text (not PDF-only) OR proven HTML alternate
